records.title: UNAUTHORISED TOLL OPERATION ON INCOMPLETE NH 748A
details: The present progress is about 71% and revised scheduled date for completion is March 2026

records.title: Strengthening Apprenticeship Programme
details: It was inter-alia stated that the renewable energy sector is projected to create about 28 lakhs jobs between August 2024 and March 2030 including 18 lakh jobs in the next three years. A significant part of the requirement is expected to be met by engineering graduates.

records.title: Steps to encourage investment in Natural Gas Production
details: To realize the vision, the Government has set a target to raise the share of natural gas in energy mix to 15% in 20230

records.title: New Industrial Policy
details: (a) to (c): It was inter-alia stated that the policy has not been finalised.

records.title: New space policy for private player's participation
details: (b) & (c) Yes, Sir. The Department of Space is in the process of formulating a comprehensive, overarching space policy, that shall bring clarity on roles of various stakeholders. The Policy has undergone extensive deliberations with industry groups, inter-ministerial consultations and is under further approval process.
